Guest work

Moose

Two books and a companion, hosted here in full at his request. Printed as he wrote them, and not part of what this site checks.

Moose on X

Satoshi’s Engine

How mining pays, how competition changes its costs, and what survives each market cycle. The story, the math, and the role of fees. Updated edition, subtitled Carnot local, Brownian global. English: 89 pages. Swedish: 88 pages.

The interactive visualization of the book was made by Kii, who already understood the physics behind Carnot engines and Brownian ratchets.

The Loops Inside the Engine: a six-page companion with feedback-loop diagrams and a view of the cycle in motion.

The Instrument

How to judge money by what it costs to make. Three parts: the case packed as tight as it goes, then the same ground walked slowly from two laws of physics, then the tool aimed at things it was not built for. 279 pages.
